ndr-space-cochin.summary: A Grade A warehousing park on the northern edge of Kochi, off SH-16 near Aluva. The site sits between Cochin International Airport and the Kochi port terminals, with the national highway and the Aluva metro and rail stations a short drive away, which suits distribution into Ernakulam and central Kerala.

faq.q: Can the space be split into smaller units?
faq.a: Yes. The building can be divided along its column grid, with each unit keeping its own dock doors and entrance.
Yes. Phase 2 is under construction, and specifications such as clear height, floor load and dock count can be adapted for a committed occupier.

faq.q: How soon can a tenant move in?
faq.a: Completed space can be handed over in a few weeks, subject to the agreed fit-out.
Storage is planned for general, non-hazardous goods. Other categories can be discussed case by case, subject to approvals.
